commit_message: Renderer: keep local light upload helper private
pr_title: Renderer: add generic point and spot lighting
pr_body:
## Summary
- add stable authoring/runtime Point Light and Spot Light components with bounded render budgets
- evaluate directional, point, and spot direct Cook-Torrance lighting in generic StandardLit while preserving IBL/AO indirect semantics
- keep directional CSM as the only shadowed direct light and keep ToonLit local-light styling deferred
- add deterministic transform-derived GPU light packing and a fixed-camera GPU regression for point/spot contribution
- keep GPU packing types module-private by narrowing the internal light upload helper
- record the contract in ADR 0123
